name: XPSemu
summary: Original Xbox (2001) emulator via xemu, with RADV Vulkan and cover flow.
description: xemu built as a native PS5 app on the RADV Vulkan driver, running the Xbox CPU through a QEMU JIT and the NV2A GPU through xemu's Vulkan renderer. Includes an Xbox-style cover flow with per-game settings and in-memory patches.
author: ZiZc3
warnings: A separate tools ELF handles the app jailbreak.
